question: Which of the following is an example of the cooperative sector industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coir Industry**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **coir industry is an example of a cooperative sector industry.**
 
• The **coir industry is a cooperative sector industry in Kerala, India. **
 
• Coir is **a natural fiber extracted from the outer husk of a coconut**.
 
• It is used to make products like brushes, doormats, floor mats, and mattresses. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cooperative sector industries**

 
 
• **​**These** industries are owned and operated by the workers or suppliers of raw materials, or both.**
 
• **Other examples of cooperative sector industries **
 
• **The sugar industry in Maharashtra**
 
• **Amul**
 
• **Kerala Co-operative Milk Marketing Federation**
 
• **Karnataka Milk Federation (KMF)**
 
• **Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative Limited**
 
• **Indian Coffee House**
 
• **Horticultural Producers' **Cooperative Marketing and Processing Society​
